summary: The PR introduces a new feature to preserve dtypes in DataFrame outputs, which is useful for maintaining data type information during transformations.

issues.description: The PR introduces a new argument `dtypes` to `_wrap_in_pandas_container`, which may not align with the existing coding style or conventions in the project.
The code could benefit from additional comments to explain the purpose of the new `dtypes` argument and how it interacts with the existing logic.
